concept: A warm pocket museum and expedition archive celebrating meaningful finds, old maps, and curious discoveries.
floor: One broad continuous polished museum-stone floor across the full top face, formed from six to eight oversized warm limestone slabs with very shallow bevels and gentle large-scale tonal variation; no grass, carpet, tiny tiles, mosaic, cracks, dirt, or repeated texture.
main_structure: One compact open-front museum pavilion at the rear with a broad terracotta arched roof, warm cream walls, one glowing doorway, and one large blank map cabinet integrated beside it.
rear_props: two simplified glass display cases with one large abstract artifact shape in each
side_props: one oversized ceramic vase on a chunky plinth and one closed expedition chest along the upper-left edge
one oversized fossil-shell sculpture on a chunky plinth and two broad rolled maps along the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth museum parapet made from broad rounded teal stone masses with warm cream caps

lighting: soft warm gallery daylight with one broad doorway glow and two restrained amber lantern glows
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open polished museum stone
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, text, labels, watermark, external shadow
grass, flowers, topiary, tiny tiles, mosaic, artifact clutter, pottery fragments, tiny map markings, pebbles, cracks, specks, or dense detail
